events.evidenceSummary: Bob's Red Mill does not publicly disclose growing regions for this SKU. We will not guess.

Bob's Red Mill mills and packages its products at its combined manufacturing, warehousing and headquarters facility in Milwaukie, Oregon — a 325,000-square-foot building it announced in 2007 — and markets this oat line directly on its own catalog page. Lot-level proof that this specific 16 oz bag was packed at Milwaukie is not published, so this stays documented rather than verified.

Distribution routing for this SKU is not publicly documented. Which distributors, warehouses, carriers, and routes move a given bag from the Milwaukie mill to a retail shelf is undisclosed; the USDA record lists the market country as the United States and nothing more specific is known.
